name: Long March 12
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: Commercial LC-2 is up to 6 launches this year, and 10 since its first in 2024. The pad had 22 days to reset after the last one.
slot_b_text: The 48th launch of the year for China's CASC, 618th all time. Their year has run at a launch every six days. Worldwide, it is attempt number 238 of the year.
rocket_fact: Long March 12 is a key player in China's growing commercial satellite internet plans.
